**Concept Used:**

Sum of all scooters = Production in all six months

**Calculation:**

Total Scooters produced in January = 100

Total Scooters produced in February = 105

Total Scooters produced in March = 108

Total Scooters produced in April = 110

Total Scooters produced in May = 110

Total Scooters produced in June = 90

Total scooters produced by the company during the first six months = 100 + 105 + 108 + 110 + 110 + 90 = 623

**Hence, the number of scooters produced by the company in the first six months are 623**
